result.title: A Stochastic Latent Variable Generalization of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
result.summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) predict the latent embedding of a target signal from a context signal, with an auxiliary variable z conditioning the predictor. Despite its prominent role in the original JEPA blueprint, the content of z has been carried by a fixed deterministic token in every prior instantiation, collapsing the genuinely multi-modal distribution over plausible completions to a point estimate. We present S-JEPA, which realises z as a proper stochastic latent variable for masked image prediction: a learned posterior infers z from context and target during training, while a learned context-conditioned prior approximates the distribution of plausible completions at inference, with no decoders and no reconstruction. In its deterministic limit the objective reduces to the I-JEPA loss in functional form, generalising that objective rather than strictly containing the I-JEPA model. Our central finding is that stochasticity adds capabilities, error-correlated predictive uncertainty and diverse completions, at no cost to representation quality: under matched architectures and schedules S-JEPA improves over the deterministic I-JEPA baseline and exceeds LeJEPA at matched architecture, while additionally producing spatially structured uncertainty maps and semantically diverse completions, neither of which the deterministic predictor produces.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 S-JEPA，在掩码图像预测的 JEPA 框架中把原本固定的条件 token z 改为由学习到的后验与先验建模的随机潜变量，在不重建像素的情况下产生预测不确定性和多样补全。
AI.relevance_reason: 其随机潜变量与多假设采样可能为 LVR 中多模态 latent 状态、候选视觉补全以及基于不确定性的停止与验证提供方法线索，但论文仍属视觉自监督预训练，向多模态推理迁移的可行性需要核查。
